DAILY PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE CHECKLIST
GENERAL VISUAL INSPECTION
1Unit casing and panels – no physical damage, corrosion, dents, or loose panels (FAHU-01 & HMU-01)
2Access doors and key locks – fully closed and secured; no door left open
3No unusual noise or vibration from supply fan or return fan during operation
4No burning smell, smoke, or overheating odour from fan motors or electrical panels
5HMU-01 (Outdoor unit): Roof area clear – no debris, sand, or objects blocking unit or airflow
HMU-01 only
OPERATIONAL STATUS CHECK
6Unit confirmed running – supply fan operating and delivering airflow to ductwork
7Return fan (FAHU-01) confirmed running and extracting return air
FAHU-01 only – HMU-01 has no return fan
8Supply air damper confirmed OPEN – no alarm indicating closed damper
9Return air damper (FAHU-01) confirmed OPEN
FAHU-01 only
10No fault codes, error lights, or alarm indicators on unit controller or BACnet panel
11DPC200 airflow/pressure display (supply fan) – reading within normal range: _____ Pa
12DPC200 airflow/pressure display (return fan – FAHU-01 only): _____ Pa
FAHU-01 only
CONDENSATE CHECK
13No water dripping or leaking from unit casing or condensate drain pan area
14No water stains, wet marks, or puddles below unit or on surrounding floor/ceiling
FILTER STATUS – VISUAL
15Filter differential pressure switch – no alarm triggered (check controller display)
16HMU-01: Check HMI controller – no filter service warning displayed
HMU-01 only
ELECTRICAL QUICK CHECK
17Main electrical isolator/circuit breaker for each unit – confirmed in ON position
18No visible burnt wiring, scorching, or heat marks near control panel or unit body
UV LAMP (HMU-01 ONLY)
Note: UV lamp inspection (visual) – HMU-01 only. FAHU-01 does not have a UV lamp section.
19HMU-01: UV lamp section microswitch operational – lamp indicator status checked
HMU-01 only
BELT / SHEAVE CHECK
Note: FAHU-01 Modular Rotary has a sorption rotary heat recovery wheel driven by a transmission belt (SPZ type). EC supply and return fans are direct-drive – no belts on fans.
20FAHU-01: Rotary heat recovery wheel – visually confirm wheel is rotating normally
FAHU-01 only
21FAHU-01: No abnormal noise from rotary wheel drive belt or motor (0.4 kW motor)
FAHU-01 only
Note: HMU-01 EC supply fan is direct-drive. HSHP is a sealed passive heat pipe – no belts. Belt check not applicable to HMU-01 fan or HSHP.
LUBRICATION CHECK
Note: EC supply fan (both units) and EC return fan (FAHU-01) use permanently sealed, factory-lubricated bearings per Daikin IOM. No external lubrication required at daily frequency.
DOCUMENTATION
22Record date, time, and inspector name in maintenance log
23Note any fault code, alarm, or abnormal condition – report to supervisor immediately
24Confirm both units (FAHU-01 and HMU-01) are accounted for in this daily inspection

DAILY PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE CHECKLIST
GENERAL VISUAL INSPECTION
1Unit casing and panels – no physical damage, corrosion, dents, or loose panels (FAHU-01 & HMU-01)
2Access doors and key locks – fully closed and secured; no door left open
3No unusual noise or vibration from supply fan or return fan during operation
4No burning smell, smoke, or overheating odour from fan motors or electrical panels
5HMU-01 (Outdoor unit): Roof area clear – no debris, sand, or objects blocking unit or airflow
HMU-01 only
OPERATIONAL STATUS CHECK
6Unit confirmed running – supply fan operating and delivering airflow to ductwork
7Return fan (FAHU-01) confirmed running and extracting return air
FAHU-01 only – HMU-01 has no return fan
8Supply air damper confirmed OPEN – no alarm indicating closed damper
9Return air damper (FAHU-01) confirmed OPEN
FAHU-01 only
10No fault codes, error lights, or alarm indicators on unit controller or BACnet panel
11DPC200 airflow/pressure display (supply fan) – reading within normal range: _____ Pa
12DPC200 airflow/pressure display (return fan – FAHU-01 only): _____ Pa
FAHU-01 only
CONDENSATE CHECK
13No water dripping or leaking from unit casing or condensate drain pan area
14No water stains, wet marks, or puddles below unit or on surrounding floor/ceiling
FILTER STATUS – VISUAL
15Filter differential pressure switch – no alarm triggered (check controller display)
16HMU-01: Check HMI controller – no filter service warning displayed
HMU-01 only
ELECTRICAL QUICK CHECK
17Main electrical isolator/circuit breaker for each unit – confirmed in ON position
18No visible burnt wiring, scorching, or heat marks near control panel or unit body
UV LAMP (HMU-01 ONLY)
Note: UV lamp inspection (visual) – HMU-01 only. FAHU-01 does not have a UV lamp section.
19HMU-01: UV lamp section microswitch operational – lamp indicator status checked
HMU-01 only
BELT / SHEAVE CHECK
Note: FAHU-01 Modular Rotary has a sorption rotary heat recovery wheel driven by a transmission belt (SPZ type). EC supply and return fans are direct-drive – no belts on fans.
20FAHU-01: Rotary heat recovery wheel – visually confirm wheel is rotating normally
FAHU-01 only
21FAHU-01: No abnormal noise from rotary wheel drive belt or motor (0.4 kW motor)
FAHU-01 only
Note: HMU-01 EC supply fan is direct-drive. HSHP is a sealed passive heat pipe – no belts. Belt check not applicable to HMU-01 fan or HSHP.
LUBRICATION CHECK
Note: EC supply fan (both units) and EC return fan (FAHU-01) use permanently sealed, factory-lubricated bearings per Daikin IOM. No external lubrication required at daily frequency.
DOCUMENTATION
22Record date, time, and inspector name in maintenance log
23Note any fault code, alarm, or abnormal condition – report to supervisor immediately
24Confirm both units (FAHU-01 and HMU-01) are accounted for in this daily inspection
